title: NPCore: Troubleshooting
summary: Recover from missing profiles, blocked trades, service cooldowns, and fallback screens.

blocks.title: Generic Or Empty Contact
blocks.body: Check whether the NPC profile id exists and whether its visual profile, dialogue, trade set, and service set all use resolvable identifiers.

blocks.title: Blocked Action
blocks.body: A trade can be out of stock, missing required items, mission-locked, or invalid. A service can be cooling down or missing its cost.

blocks.title: Fallback Screen
blocks.body: If the ScreenCore page is absent, disabled, or declined, NPCore should still open the classic interaction screen. That is a fallback, not a broken contact.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
